decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY recording that the tribute page is required; its placement is independently owned by the source Requirement, so no candidate Event needs editing.
Adding a tribute page near the end does not change the requirement to request supplemental images when needed for article layout balance.
The tribute page placement does not alter the required digital flipbook deliverable.
The source does not change any image-quality or enhancement rule.
Adding and positioning the tribute page does not change the digital launch deadline or launch target.
The source specifies content placement but does not modify the magazine's visual style, branding reference, or color rules.
The tribute page instruction does not change author-name, author-photo, coverage, or photo-source requirements.
The tribute page placement does not alter treatment of long article text or the use of blurbs, quotes, and additional images.
